messages.subject: SECR error: "noccasions"
parts:
Hi all 
First time poster and very new to coding and all things R/secr related.

I am getting an error which I can not seem to resolve.
I am trying to run density estimates for cheetahs in Kruger National Park, South Africa but am getting an error which I can not seem to resolve.
I have made 100% sure that my Trap Files and Capture Files are both correct and that there are no detectors on the one and not in the other. I have also consulted Chat GPT in the hopes to get some more information, but nothing has provided any luck. 
When I create a Capture History object I run this line:

> cptr_hst <- read.capthist("CaptFile2122FemalesAndOffspring.csv", "C:/Users/Jeanette/Desktop/PhD/ALL data/SECR/2021-22/2122 Females and Offspring/TrapFile2122AllCheetahs.csv", detector = "proximity", fmt = "trapID", skip = 1)
> ?read.capthist

 But I then get the the following error:
 Error in make.capthist(capt, trps, fmt = fmt, noccasions = noccasions, : failed to match some capture locations to detector sites

You will notice that the names on the TrapFile and Captfile is not the same. The example I pasted was based on the TrapFile for locations/detectors of all identifiable cheetahs observed during our census period. This was just done as another attempt to try and resolve the issue, however when I use the TrapFile for the "Females and Offspring" (which goes with the associated Capture File) - I still get the same error.

I have compared the Capture Files and Trap Files in Excel to "highlight" any differences in the detectors between these to files - but it still does not show that there are any differences. 
I am sure that the [problem is something easy to fix - but my untrained eyes simply can not see it.

Would appreciate any help so much.
TIA...
Jeanette
